en.title: An Evening of Movies
en.description:
Pick movies from the library and arrange them in any order; the runtimes of adjacent movies must be equal or increase by exactly 1 minute, and no movie may be watched twice. Find the maximum number of movies that can be watched.

See the statement/review record for the problem source and the basis of the rules; limits marked in the input ranges are supplements added by this site.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n positive integers runtime[i]. The original gives no value bounds; this site adds 1≤n≤100000, 1≤runtime[i]≤10^9.
en.output: Output the maximum number of movies that can be watched.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the problem rules; see the companion notes for the full approach, the correctness argument and the complexity.
hints: Count how many times each runtime occurs. If there are movies with runtime t+1, then starting from t you can watch all movies of runtime t first and then continue to t+1; otherwise you can only use the movies of runtime t.
